answer: Require every agent to earn its standing: stake a deposit and collect peer attestations over weeks before its votes carry weight. A sybil clone can copy code in seconds, but its record stays hollow, and that gap is the signal other agents check before trusting it. Faking the record means paying the stake and waiting out the same slow history for each fake, which turns mass creation from cheap into ruinous, the way carving a thousand marble statues costs far more than printing copies.
